_comment: Store listing images. Edit copy and palettes here, not in generate.py.
_propositions: Both sets say the same six things in the same order. Only the capture differs, so a copy change means editing two entries, not two sets of images.

images.headline: Your home screen opens with a keyboard
images.sub: No swiping through pages of icons. Just type.

images.headline: Search inside apps, not just for them
images.sub: y for YouTube, m for Maps, w for Wikipedia. Add your own for anything else.

images.headline: Answers without a calculator app
images.sub: Type the sum. Tap the result to copy it.

images.headline: Add a widget by typing its name
images.sub: No long press, no scrolling a tray.

images.headline: A browser with ad blocking built in
images.sub: Web results open here, not in another app.

images.headline: Every tab, one swipe from the home screen
images.sub: Swipe up on the search bar to see them all.
